item.title: Combiner 0.5.0
item.description:
• Each project has its own Stems folder and strips (stable project ids)
  • Transfers resume, stall out and back off (Mac + web)
  • ORIGINAL where the sound first plays; Fader + pan setting; 24-bit renders
  • Write down snapshot ordering and old project versions
  • ⚙︎ When a track is deleted from its project (hide, grey out, stop sharing)
  • Share every synth's patch (Surge, Vital, any AU synth), not just Serum's
  • Slices of a chopped take (take + slice points, Mac and web)
  • Rooms and songs (each song remembers its room)
  • A download page and Sparkle updates for friends
  • Release.sh is executable
